main_measure.name: OLS slope of excess forward 20-bar return (minus coin-window mean 20-bar return) on forecast, pooled, non-overlapping 20-bar blocks
main_measure.threshold: confirm if slope > 0 with t >= 2 (and supporting share > 50%); reject if slope < 0 with t <= -2; inconclusive otherwise or if fewer than 30 non-overlapping 20-bar periods with non-zero forecast

supporting_check.name: share of non-overlapping 20-bar short periods with forward return below coin-window median 20-bar return

decided_by: The slope on the forecast is negative with t <= -2: price rises relative to holding the further below the average.
reading: The regression uses all bars (including zero forecast) on the 0, 20, 40, ... grid of each window, with the coin's mean and median 20-bar return taken over all overlapping forward returns in that window, and a supporting share not above 50% blocks confirmation.
